messages:
Maya (docs): hey team, opening a tiny refresh PR for the Quickstart 'hello app'. Goals: move examples to SDK v7 imports, show browser-based OAuth dev-portal flow for ephemeral tokens, and bump sample to node:20. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899 — i'd love a snippet sanity check and a quick local run.

Ben (eng): looking now. curious: browser OAuth example ok for labs? workshop instructors often prefer CLI tokens for reproducibility.

Maya (docs): agreed — adding both flows. default in the tutorial will demonstrate the dev-portal OAuth (short path) and an appendix shows the CLI exchange for automation.

Alexa (devex): FYI the quickstart generator currently emits `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` in v6 style. i'll patch generator to output `import { createClient } from '@redwood/client'` and the new responses API shape.

Sam (qa): i'll run the docker smoke test. what's the container run snippet?

Maya (docs): paste from PR:
```
# build
docker build -t rw-hello:v1 .
# OAuth path: run with RW_DEV_PORTAL=true so tutorial shows popup flow
docker run -e RW_DEV_PORTAL=true -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:v1
# CLI token path:
docker run -e RW_API_KEY=sk_test_... -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:v1
# smoke: curl localhost:3000/api/greet -> {"message":"Hello from Redwood"}
```
Add note about node 20 requirement.

Ben (eng): found an outdated sample line: `client.chat.completions.create(...)` should be `client.responses.generate(...)` in v7. Also dockerfile used `NODE:14` in a base image  will switch to `node:20-alpine`. I'll push a commit to the branch with those two fixes.

Jason (pm): please keep a migration blurb: old workshop materials referencing `RW_TOKEN` or `client.chat` should map to new names. maybe a little table in the docs.

Maya (docs): adding migration table and a short troubleshooting FAQ. also expanding the OAuth appendix with exact dev-portal steps and redirect URI sample.

Alexa (devex): small lint nit: example had double quotes vs single. our code style CI will fail. i'll run prettier on the examples before merging.

lifecycle-bot: CI triggered for branch quickstart/refresh-899  build 2184 queued.

Sam (qa): quick note while testing: the app fails if RW_DEV_PORTAL is set but REDWOOD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is missing  throws a 500 on /auth/callback. we should surface that in the README and return a helpful error message instead of stacktrace.

Ben (eng): good catch. i'll wrap the callback handler with a check and a friendly response. will include an example env snippet in the README.

Maya (docs): perfect. also adding the sample env block: `REDWOOD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=dev-abc123`, `REDWOOD_OAUTH_REDIRECT=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback`.

Alexa (devex): pushed formatter + generator patch. also updated the embed snippets to use the new `await client.responses.generate({ model: 'rw-large', input: prompt })` pattern.

lifecycle-bot: build 2184 failed in docs-lint step (examples/hello/app.js: trailing comma).

Maya (docs): i'll fix the trailing comma in the PR now.

Sam (qa): reran local container after Ben's callback guard and Alexa's patches  smoke passes. curl /api/greet returns expected message.

lifecycle-bot: build 2185 started for quickstart/refresh-899.

Ben (eng): one more runtime tweak: we had `cache: true` in the example batching config; runtime expects `sessionCache: 'enabled'` now. updated in branch.

Maya (docs): thanks. final ask: can we include a tiny troubleshooting checklist at the top of the tutorial (ports, node version, env vars)? saves a lot of instructor time.

Jason (pm): thumbs up to checklist. Also flagging a short note for support: if customers are following the old slides, they might hit the node version mismatch — support should use the migration table.

lifecycle-bot: build 2185 passed  preview available at https://deploy-preview-899.redwood.dev

Maya (docs): preview looks good. merging in 5. thanks everyone for quick reviews. :party_parrot:

Alexa (devex): sweet — i'll update the quickstart generator release notes and bump the example templates package.
